svg.aria-label: Bar chart of the table below: how many times faster oneyaml-csharp is than the strongest competitor on each task, log scale, higher is better. 7 tasks: 5 better, 0 level, 1 mixed, 0 worse, 1 not comparable.
svg.title: oneyaml-csharp: speed per task against the strongest competitor
svg.desc: oneyaml-csharp: speed per task against the strongest competitor. Times faster than the strongest competitor on each task (geometric mean over its workloads), log scale: bars to the right are faster, higher is better, bars to the left are slower. Unchanged emit times the write path of a document that was not edited; a library that keeps the text returns it without rendering, so it is not a rendering speed. A † marks a cell measured differently from the task as specified. typed load 1.24× faster win (ours 51.1 µs vs 63.5 µs; workloads: 1 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 1); generic load 1.45× faster win (ours 26.5 µs vs 38.3 µs; workloads: 7 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 7); dump 2.67× faster win (ours 7.92 µs vs 21.2 µs; workloads: 6 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 6); document parse 12.2× faster win (ours 19.1 µs vs 234 µs; workloads: 7 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 7); unchanged emit (write-back of an unedited document; not a rendering speed) 1.66× slower mixed (ours 1.35 µs vs 814 ns; workloads: 1 better, 0 level, 6 worse of 7); edit script 51.3× faster win (ours 12.1 µs vs 620 µs; workloads: 6 better, 0 level, 0 worse of 6); patch (RFC 6902) no rival.
